verdict.rationale: Lindy has a credentials store for keys the agent uses when running shell commands and code. Keys are private to the saving user until shared with the whole workspace, and Guardrails control what Lindy can do without asking. That gives coarse visibility scoping and action gating, but nothing shows Lindy issuing purpose-scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: issuing agent-specific API keys, per-credential permission/scope restriction, finer-grained sharing than user-or-whole-workspace, expiry/rotation/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
